mapper.sql: id, org_id, request_type, status, channel, requester_name, subject_name, subject_email, subject_workspace_id, subject_person_id, received_at, identity_verified_at, due_at, responded_at, closed_at, summary, resolution, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_subject_request (org_id, request_type, status, channel, requester_name, subject_name, subject_email, subject_workspace_id, subject_person_id, received_at, identity_verified_at, due_at, responded_at, closed_at, summary, resolution, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{requestType}, #{status}, #{channel}, #{requesterName}, #{subjectName}, #{subjectEmail}, #{subjectWorkspaceId}, #{subjectPersonId}, COALESCE(#{receivedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{identityVerifiedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{respondedAt}, #{closedAt}, #{summary}, #{resolution}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE data_subject_request SET request_type = #{requestType}, status = #{status}, channel = #{channel}, requester_name = #{requesterName}, subject_name = #{subjectName}, subject_email = #{subjectEmail}, subject_workspace_id = #{subjectWorkspaceId}, subject_person_id = #{subjectPersonId}, received_at = COALESCE(#{receivedAt}, received_at), identity_verified_at = #{identityVerifiedAt}, due_at = #{dueAt}, responded_at = #{respondedAt}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, summary = #{summary}, resolution = #{resolution}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.workspace_id, p.name, p.email, p.phone, p.title, CASE WHEN company_workspace.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.id END AS company_id, CASE WHEN company_workspace.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.name END AS company_name, p.image_url, p.risk_excluded, p.intro_excluded, p.suspended_at, p.provision_ceased_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM person p JOIN workspace subject_workspace ON subject_workspace.id = p.workspace_id AND subject_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = p.company_id LEFT JOIN workspace company_workspace ON company_workspace.id = c.workspace_id AND company_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId}

SELECT v.id, v.workspace_id, v.definition_id, d.field_key, d.label, d.field_type, d.data_classification, d.options_json, d.required, d.position, d.archived, v.value_text, v.value_number, v.value_date, v.value_bool, v.created_at, v.updated_at FROM person p JOIN workspace subject_workspace ON subject_workspace.id = p.workspace_id AND subject_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN custom_field_value v ON v.entity_type = 'person' AND v.entity_id = p.id JOIN workspace value_workspace ON value_workspace.id = v.workspace_id AND value_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN custom_field_definition d ON d.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND d.id = v.definition_id AND d.entity_type = 'person' WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId} ORDER BY v.workspace_id, d.position, d.id

SELECT e.id, e.workspace_id, e.source_person_id, e.target_person_id, CASE WHEN e.source_person_id = p.id THEN e.target_person_id ELSE e.source_person_id END AS counterpart_person_id, counterpart.name AS counterpart_person_name, e.type, e.strength, e.note, e.created_at FROM person p JOIN workspace subject_workspace ON subject_workspace.id = p.workspace_id AND subject_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN person_edge e ON e.source_person_id = p.id OR e.target_person_id = p.id JOIN workspace edge_workspace ON edge_workspace.id = e.workspace_id AND edge_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN person counterpart ON counterpart.id = CASE WHEN e.source_person_id = p.id THEN e.target_person_id ELSE e.source_person_id END JOIN workspace counterpart_workspace ON counterpart_workspace.id = counterpart.workspace_id AND counterpart_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT d.workspace_id, d.id AS deal_id, d.name AS deal_name, s.id AS stage_id, s.name AS stage_name, dp.role FROM person p JOIN workspace subject_workspace ON subject_workspace.id = p.workspace_id AND subject_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN deal_person dp ON dp.person_id = p.id JOIN deal d ON d.id = dp.deal_id JOIN workspace deal_workspace ON deal_workspace.id = d.workspace_id AND deal_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN stage s ON s.id = d.stage_id JOIN workspace stage_workspace ON stage_workspace.id = s.workspace_id AND stage_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT i.id, i.workspace_id, i.introducer_user_id, i.person_a_id, person_a.name AS person_a_name, i.person_b_id, person_b.name AS person_b_name, i.status, i.note, i.introduced_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM person p JOIN workspace subject_workspace ON subject_workspace.id = p.workspace_id AND subject_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN introduction i ON i.person_a_id = p.id OR i.person_b_id = p.id JOIN workspace introduction_workspace ON introduction_workspace.id = i.workspace_id AND introduction_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN person person_a ON person_a.id = i.person_a_id JOIN workspace person_a_workspace ON person_a_workspace.id = person_a.workspace_id AND person_a_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN person person_b ON person_b.id = i.person_b_id JOIN workspace person_b_workspace ON person_b_workspace.id = person_b.workspace_id AND person_b_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId} ORDER BY i.introduced_at DESC, i.id DESC

SELECT target_workspace.id AS target_workspace_id, target_workspace.name AS target_workspace_name, ps.granted_by, ps.can_edit, ps.created_at FROM person p JOIN workspace subject_workspace ON subject_workspace.id = p.workspace_id AND subject_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN person_share ps ON ps.person_id = p.id JOIN workspace target_workspace ON target_workspace.id = ps.workspace_id AND target_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId} ORDER BY ps.created_at DESC, target_workspace.id

SELECT al.action, al.actor_label, al.outcome, al.summary, al.created_at FROM person p JOIN workspace subject_workspace ON subject_workspace.id = p.workspace_id AND subject_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN audit_log al ON al.entity_type = 'person' AND al.entity_id = p.id LEFT JOIN workspace audit_workspace ON audit_workspace.id = al.workspace_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId} AND ((al.workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND audit_workspace.org_id = #{orgId}) OR (al.workspace_id IS NULL AND al.org_id = #{orgId}) OR (al.workspace_id IS NULL AND al.org_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY al.created_at DESC, al.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person p JOIN workspace subject_workspace ON subject_workspace.id = p.workspace_id AND subject_workspace.org_id = #{orgId} JOIN audit_log al ON al.entity_type = 'person' AND al.entity_id = p.id LEFT JOIN workspace audit_workspace ON audit_workspace.id = al.workspace_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = #{personId} AND ((al.workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND audit_workspace.org_id = #{orgId}) OR (al.workspace_id IS NULL AND al.org_id = #{orgId}) OR (al.workspace_id IS NULL AND al.org_id IS NULL))
